name: Brackenwall Village
summary: In the northwest marsh, Brackenwall Village shelters the Stonemaul ogres. Black dragonkin drove them from their southern home, and spies, deserters, and the black dragonflight now threaten the refuge.

sections.title: Refuge of the Stonemaul
sections.body:
Overlord Mok'Morokk led the Stonemaul survivors north after black dragonkin drove them from their ancient home at Stonemaul Village. Successor to Rexxar, he gathered the clan in the swamp to build Brackenwall. Earthen mounds, huts, and an old watchtower give the battered ogres a refuge they can defend.

Brackenwall is allied with the Horde, but Mok'Morokk sits idle, hoards supplies, and refuses to face the draconic threat. The ogre mage Draz'Zilb and Horde emissaries give the clan spiritual and tactical guidance.

sections.title: Eyes in the Bog
sections.body:
Theramore infiltrators watch Brackenwall from the thickets and report the village's movements to the island fortress. Paval Reethe, a Theramore deserter cast out from Lost Point, is suspected of stealing vital supplies from the outpost.

Wary eyes watch from the east as black drakes prowl the southern reaches. Brackenwall remains an isolated Horde staging ground against the Alliance and Onyxia's brood.

faq.q: Why are there ogres allied with the Horde here?
faq.answer: The Stonemaul ogres joined the modern Horde through Rexxar, their champion during the founding of Durotar. After defeating their former leader, Rexxar became their chieftain and bound the clan to Warchief Thrall's coalition. He later passed leadership to Mok'Morokk.

faq.q: Why did the Stonemaul settle here instead of staying in their old home?
faq.answer: Black dragonkin overran and destroyed the Stonemaul's ancestral settlement in southern Dustwallow Marsh. Overlord Mok'Morokk led the displaced survivors north through the bog to build Brackenwall as a fortified refuge.

faq.q: Who is in charge of Brackenwall Village?
faq.answer: Overlord Mok'Morokk leads Brackenwall, though many resent his rule. He cowers in the village instead of rallying the ogres to reclaim their homeland or confront the dragons. The ogre mage Draz'Zilb and Horde envoys manage daily crises.

faq.q: Why are there Theramore spies outside the village?
faq.answer: Theramore's military watches Horde troop movements in Dustwallow despite the fragile truce between Theramore and Orgrimmar. Infiltrators circle Brackenwall and report on ogre strength and Horde operations.

angles.text: Brackenwall is your only sanctuary and flight connection in the marsh. Defending it helps the Horde keep a vital listening post and defensive flank against Theramore.
Brackenwall lies deep in hostile territory. Investigations into the missing diplomat and rogue Theramore deserters will bring daring agents to the edge of the ogre encampment.
